name: @glyphtex/server
description: GlyphTeX Teams server: accounts, project storage and sharing.

HYPERDRIVE.description: Connection to your Postgres (Neon, Supabase, PlanetScale Postgres or self-hosted).

CACHE.description: KV namespace for short-lived cache entries.

BLOBS.description: R2 bucket for images, PDFs and fonts inside projects.

JOBS.description: Queue for emails and file cleanup. Failed jobs go to glyphtex-jobs-dead.

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: At least 32 random characters: openssl rand -base64 48

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Resend key for sign-in, verification and invite emails.

PUBLIC_URL.description: Where this API is reachable, e.g. https://api.example.com

APP_URL.description: Where the GlyphTeX web app is, e.g. https://glyphtex.example.com
